fishing.note: Each zone's fishing skill and what its water gives are Classic data (CMaNGOS): from the zone's skill + 95 nothing gets away (a skill below 0 is Classic's way of saying any skill will do). caughtInForever is what ForeverDB players' addons caught there.

herbalism.note: The skill each node needs comes from the Forever client; where nodes spawn is Classic data (CMaNGOS) until players' addons record them in Forever (spotsSeenInForever).

mining.note: The skill each node needs comes from the Forever client; where nodes spawn is Classic data (CMaNGOS) until players' addons record them in Forever (spotsSeenInForever).

skinning.note: Beasts, their levels and where they spawn are Classic data (CMaNGOS); the skill each needs follows Classic's rule (1 up to level 10, then (level - 10) x 10 up to 20, then level x 5). seenInForever: a player's addon saw it in Forever.
